home_intro.badge: 100% Open Source · Go + Next.js · Made for Vibers
home_intro.description: A fast, modern, open-source ecommerce starter. Go API + Next.js storefront. Simple to set up. Easy to extend. Built for AI to easy handling.
home_intro.features_title: Everything you need, nothing you don't

features.go_desc: Chi router, raw database/sql, goose migrations, Redis caching. No ORMs, no bloat. Just fast, idiomatic Go.
features.nextjs_desc: App Router, React 19, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui + HeroUI. Server components by default. Feels instant.
features.modular_desc: 7 feature modules: catalog, cart, checkout, orders, customers, shipping, admin. Plugin-style registration. Add features without touching core.
features.cart_desc: Cookie-based cart, multi-step checkout, Stripe payments, shipping zones with Omniva integration.
features.admin_desc: Session auth + CSRF + Cloudflare Turnstile captcha. Manage products, orders, customers, CMS pages, email templates.
features.theme_desc: Override any page or component from your safe zone. Never conflicts with upstream updates. Brand tokens in one file.

home_intro.cta_desc: 100% open source. Made for Vibers. Fork it, customize it, ship it.
